skill_draft.description: When interpreting chest imaging findings for differential diagnosis, verify that the specific radiographic texture and anatomical distribution align with the classic presentation of the suspected condition before finalizing the diagnosis.
skill_draft.applicable_conditions: Tasks involving the interpretation of chest X-ray or CT descriptions to distinguish between pulmonary conditions with overlapping clinical symptoms but distinct radiographic features.
skill_draft.core_action: If a diagnosis is selected based on radiographic findings: (1) explicitly compare the described texture (e.g., reticulonodular, ground-glass, hyperlucency) and distribution (e.g., upper vs. lower zone, perihilar vs. peripheral) against the canonical radiographic signature of the top differential; (2) reject the diagnosis if the pattern contradicts the classic presentation (e.g., do not diagnose PJP if findings are strictly basal reticulonodular without ground-glass opacity); (3) prioritize alternatives that match the specific spatial and textural nuances described.
